Good to know

Frequently Asked Questions

Are you really available 24 hours a day?
Yes. Dan’s Towing & Recovery operates 24/7, every day of the year — nights, weekends and holidays included. Call Springfield at (937) 202-0273 or Urbana at (937) 202-0278 any time.
How much does a tow cost?
Call either location for a quote: Springfield at (937) 202-0273 or Urbana at (937) 202-0278.
Can you tow a semi truck, RV or bus?
Yes. Heavy-duty towing is a core part of what we do — trucks, RVs and buses included — along with crane services and machinery moving and rigging for commercial jobs.
I’m locked out / my battery is dead. Do I need a tow?
Our roadside assistance covers battery jump starts, flat tire changes, fuel delivery and lockout service — plus winch-outs and off-road recovery.
Do you work with insurance companies?
Yes. We work directly with insurance companies and handle the paperwork for your tow, so an accident doesn’t turn into a paperwork headache on top of everything else.
Where are you located?
Our headquarters is at 1750 Titus Rd, Springfield, OH 45502, with a second yard at 507 Orange St, Urbana, OH 43078. From both locations we serve Springfield, Urbana and the surrounding counties.
Who will be operating the truck?
A WreckMaster certified operator from a family-owned company that has been doing this work since 1985 — over four decades of towing and recovery experience behind every call.
